title: X01 E2E protocol: concurrent export stage on top of the accepted X02 dispatch, bitwise A/B vs the Phase-0 baseline corpus
frozen_before_timing: 2026-10-16, commit 987fbd82 (the X01 concurrent-export commit); no timing run has happened under this protocol

change_under_test.summary: _calculate_svf's serial parent export loop becomes a spawn-pool concurrent stage (degree = runtime.workers, per-tile service code unchanged and lock-protected); documented amendment to publication order + failure truncation
change_under_test.note: the product diff vs the Phase-0 base includes the accepted X02 dispatch (9133c693 + docstring 4d958dbb); X01's own delta is api.py only

driver: /storage/scratch1/1/dsynn6/solweig-light-s11-raw/phase1/x01_e2e.py (hard-asserts protocol commit ancestry, product-diff file list + sha, scene manifest sha before any timed work; preflight mode)

scene.per_arm: fresh cold copy to node-local /tmp/s11_x01_<tag>; .solweig-light and SVF wiped before the pass (cold C6-40 phase route, p1c pattern)

b1.purpose: X02+X01 chain at the default shape; degree 3 export pool

baseline_anchor.record: phase1/x02_b1_38.json (job 14094558, earlier today, same allocation class): chain 5636.2 s = walls 20.2 + svf 3055.0 (barrier 346.8 + export stage 2708.2) + run 2561.0; bitwise 24/24
baseline_anchor.no_baseline_rerun: the anchor was measured under the frozen X02 protocol hours ago on the same machine class; a second timed baseline pass would burn an expensive slot without new information

timing_rules.passes: exactly one timed chain pass; untimed 64^2 prime first (shared NUMBA_CACHE_DIR)
timing_rules.retries: zero; a single causal retry is permitted only on a documented infrastructure anomaly (crash, node eviction, admission refusal), never on an undesired number
timing_rules.segments: perf_counter around run_walls_aspect, _calculate_svf, run_utci_tiles; barrier via the parent execute_geometry_phase seam (p1b pattern); per-tile export walls via the env-gated sitecustomize hook in spawn children (S11_X01_TIMING), cross-checked against svf_phase_s - geometry_barrier_s
timing_rules.run_flags: full save-flag set, matching the X02 E2E and the S10-36 A-arm conditions

bitwise_criteria.svf: all 24 tiles x all persisted SVF artifacts equal vs p1c_svf_base38 (probe_lib.compare_svf_artifacts, uint4-view NaN-mask equality); any diff = candidate rejected
bitwise_criteria.tmrt: TMRT_0_0.tif all bands equal vs p2_ref_TMRT.tif

acceptance.accept_x01: bitwise criteria PASS and export stage (svf_phase_s - geometry_barrier_s) <= 2200 s (>= 1.23x on the measured serial 2708.2 s; ideal 3-way is ~903 s, the gate leaves generous contention headroom while still proving real concurrency)
acceptance.sanity_watch: barrier within ~15% of 346.8 and run within +/-10% of 2561.0 flag machine drift; export_child_total vs stage wall cross-check (scheduler overhead visible)
acceptance.recorded_not_gated: achieved degree (export_child_reports must be 24), per-tile wall distribution, spawn overhead

environment.numba: NUMBA_CACHE_DIR shared with Phase 0; threading_layer omp
environment.origin: repo .venv editable install of branch src; job echoes git rev-parse HEAD + product diff file list

review_gate: independent review agent must inspect the accepted diff (mandated for every numerical/scheduling change) before the candidate is marked accepted in REGISTER.md; the review focuses on the documented contract amendment (publication order + failure truncation), admission/memory view of concurrent children, spawn/fork safety, and failure propagation semantics
